speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated 17-hydroxyprogesterone strongly suggests Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, likely due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency. Let me check your androgen levels to confirm this diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Testosterone_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated testosterone confirms hyperandrogenism consistent with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, explaining the ambiguous genitalia and acne.
